(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method for generating a superframe preamble for a superframe, the superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols, in an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) network, comprising: for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over at least a portion of the carrier; and for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The method as set forth in Claim 1, the second set of subcarriers distributed over at least a portion of the carrier.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over at least a portion of the carrier.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over at least a portion of the carrier, according to a predetermined pattern.

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: A superframe generator in a base station in an OFDM network, comprising a preamble generator operable to generate a superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols for a superframe by (i) for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over at least a portion of the carrier, and (ii) for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel.

(Currently Amended) Claim 20: The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over at least a portion of the carrier.

(Currently Amended) Claim 21: The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over at least a portion of the carrier, according to a predetermined pattern.
